crossRefs.note: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish…
the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

people.name: Eglon
people.line: Amorite king of Lachish; city in Judah

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, to Eglon; and they encamped against it and fought against it.
translations.bsb: So Joshua moved on from Lachish to Eglon, and all Israel with him. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
